d: We are seeking an experienced Chief Accountant (Payroll) to oversee payroll operations, employee compensation accounting, statutory compliance, and financial reporting across our hospitality and food & beverage businesses. The successful candidate will ensure accurate and timely payroll processing, compliance with Qatar labor regulations, reconciliation of payroll accounts, and the implementation of strong financial controls.

This role is ideal for finance professionals from hospitality groups, restaurant chains, catering companies, central kitchens, hotel operations, or large multi-site organizations with strong expertise in SAP ERP systems, payroll accounting, and advanced Excel reporting.
Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing for employees across multiple locations.
Ensure the accurate calculation of salaries, overtime, leave payments, bonuses, deductions, and final settlements.
Review payroll changes including new hires, promotions, transfers, and terminations.
Verify payroll accuracy before submission and payment processing.
Prepare payroll journal entries and month-end payroll accruals.
Ensure payroll costs are accurately allocated across departments and cost centers.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
Manage payroll transactions and reporting through SAP ERP.
Maintain employee master data within SAP.
Generate payroll reports, cost analyses, and management dashboards.
Support ERP enhancements and payroll process improvements.
Ensure compliance with Qatar Labor Law, company policies, and audit requirements.
Maintain payroll documentation and employee records.
Implement and strengthen payroll controls to mitigate financial risks.
Prepare payroll variance analyses and labor cost reports.
Provide workforce cost insights to Finance and HR leadership.
Monitor payroll KPIs, labor budgets, and workforce expenses.
Develop automated reports and dashboards using Excel.
Collaborate closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Operations, and Finance teams.
Serve as the key point of contact for payroll-related matters.
Provide payroll guidance and support to department heads.
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.
CPA, ACCA, CMA, CIMA, or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.
Minimum 3 years in a Chief Accountant, Payroll Manager, Senior Payroll Accountant, or similar leadership role.
Retail or FMCG Organizations with large employee populations
Strong SAP ERP experience (SAP FI/CO, SAP HCM Payroll, SAP SuccessFactors preferred).
Experience with Power BI is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of payroll accounting and financial controls.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to manage payroll deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

في ويستن، نحن ملتزمون بتمكين الضيوف من استعادة السيطرة وتعزيز رفاهيتهم عندما يكونون في أمس الحاجة إليها أثناء السفر، مما يضمن قدرتهم على أن يكونوا أفضل نسخة من أنفسهم. لتحقيق مهمة العلامة التجارية المتمثلة في أن تصبح العلامة التجارية الرائدة في مجال العافية في مجال الضيافة، نحتاج إلى شركاء متحمسين ومشاركين لإضفاء الحيوية على البرامج الفريدة للعلامة التجارية. نريد أن يتبنى شركاؤنا ممارسات الرفاهية الخاصة بهم داخل وخارج الممتلكات. أنت المرشح المثالي لويستن إذا كنت متحمسًا؛ أنت نشط وتفخر بكيفية الحفاظ على رفاهيتك؛ أنت متفائل؛ أنت مغامر. كن في المكان الذي يمكنك فيه القيام بأفضل أعمالك، وابدأ هدفك ، وانتمي إلى فريق عالمي مذهل ، لتصبح أفضل نسخة منك.
